title: Delivery settings
chainHint: One fixed fee for all eligible deliveries. No per-km surcharge or order-value free shipping. Only Admin can change this.
radiusHint: Straight-line distance from the branch to the delivery pin. Leave blank to disable delivery; pickup remains available. Save the branch coordinates on the map first.
branchIncomplete: Delivery radius or branch coordinates are missing
areaNote: Area description (does not replace the configured radius)
